name: OpenAI-Compatible API (any provider)
author: STORYFOUNDRY
description: Connect ANY OpenAI-compatible endpoint — OpenRouter, Groq, Together, Fireworks, DeepSeek, Mistral, Ollama, LM Studio, or your own proxy — for text, images and voice. You supply base URL, key and model.

provider.docs: Works with any service that implements the OpenAI REST schema (/chat/completions, /images/generations, /audio/speech).
